_comment: Stock materials for tools/cad recipes (LLF-69). parts[].material names a key here. densityKgM3 drives manifest massKg/inertia; pbr is passed to cad_export_body.materialsOverride as {name, pbrMetallicRoughness:pbr}. Add a stock here (with a source) before using it in a recipe. 'effective-*' stocks are for parts modelled solid that are really hollow assemblies: their density is the spec-sheet weight divided by the modelled volume.

a380-diecast-grey.source: A380 die-casting alloy 2.71 g/cc (NADCA); grey powder-coat finish

effective-cobra-head-luminaire.source: 50 lb (22.7 kg) cobra-head luminaire (shineretrofits 20 ft pole listing) / 0.02912 m^3 modelled housing envelope

ductile-iron-red.source: ASTM A536 ductile iron 7.1 g/cc; red enamel hydrant finish

bronze.source: C83600 leaded red brass/bronze 8.83 g/cc (AWWA C502 operating-nut material)

pine.source: USDA Wood Handbook FPL-GTR-190 Table 5-3a: southern pine ~0.51 specific gravity at 12% MC

oak.source: USDA Wood Handbook: red oak ~0.63-0.75 g/cc at 12% MC

steel-black-enamel.source: Carbon steel 7.85 g/cc; JNR steam locomotive black enamel finish

steel-red-oxide.source: Carbon steel 7.85 g/cc; red buffer-beam paint

effective-c57-body.source: JNR C57 engine weight 67.5 t (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/JNR_Class_C57) minus the steel motion set and steel chassis parts, divided by the 45.7 m^3 envelope modelled solid (frame, boiler, cab, cylinders, steam chests)

effective-c57-tender.source: C57 tender in working order 48 t (115.5 t total minus 67.5 t engine, en.wikipedia.org/wiki/JNR_Class_C57) minus steel bogies/wheels/underframe and the coal load, over the 35.6 m^3 tank modelled solid (water + plate)

coal.source: Bituminous coal bulk density ~830 kg/m^3 (engineeringtoolbox.com bulk material densities)

effective-coach-body.source: 33 t tare (assumed Suha 43 class figure) minus steel bogies/wheels/underframe, roof and glass, over the 110.2 m^3 body box modelled solid; JNR grape-brown (budo-iro) paint

effective-coach-roof.source: Painted canvas on timber roof boards over carlines, modelled as a solid arch: ~2.2 t roof (assumed) / 14.9 m^3

effective-underframe.source: Riveted steel channel underframe modelled as a solid slab: ~6 t for a 20 m coach (assumed) / 12.4 m^3

effective-bogie-frame.source: TR23 bogie (weblio.jp/content/TR23) less its wheels, ~2.4 t (assumed), modelled as a 3200 x 940 x 270 mm block

ballast-granite.source: Crushed granite track ballast bulk density ~1.6-1.8 t/m^3 (AREMA ballast guidance)

creosoted-timber.source: Creosote-treated hardwood/pine sleeper ~0.8 g/cc (USDA Wood Handbook + preservative retention)

hinoki-vermilion.source: Hinoki (Chamaecyparis obtusa) 0.41 g/cc air-dry (Wood Database); shu (vermilion) lacquer finish

lantern-firebox.source: Granite fire box of the stone lantern (scene lights its emissive at NIGHT / LANTERN)

effective-pagoda-body.source: Timber-framed pagoda storey modelled solid: ~250 kg/m^3 effective (assumed: ~300 t pagoda over ~1100 m^3 envelope)

kawara-roof.source: Kawara clay tiles on timber roof framing modelled as solid lofts: ~400 kg/m^3 effective (assumed)

keyaki-door.source: Keyaki (Zelkova serrata) 0.69 g/cc (Wood Database); palace gate door leaves

roof-sheet-green.source: Painted corrugated steel canopy on purlins modelled as a solid gable: ~300 kg/m^3 effective (assumed)

effective-bus-body.source: 7 t small bus kerb weight (Isuzu Journey class) less wheels, over the 31.7 m^3 body box modelled solid; kindergarten yellow

effective-machiya-body.source: Timber-framed machiya with plaster walls modelled as solid storey boxes: ~150 kg/m^3 effective (assumed: ~20 t house over ~250 m^3)
